name: Ancient Rogue
look: a primeval sage-grey Rayquaza outlined in red, coiled in an S, with glowing green orbs and plumes of fiery feathers bursting from its head, shoulders and back
entry: A Pokémon resembling Rayquaza, described in an old book of legends about a serpent of fire that ruled the sky before the ozone. Its fiery plumes leave trails of embers across the clouds.
how: Wild: very rare high on mountain peaks (above y 140).
